scenario.title: 私下聊主管、同事和辦公室氣氛
scenario.context: 私下聊職場人事時，常會補充說明：「新來的主管，就是那個從新加坡調來的，他…」。這種「補充資訊」的子句前後要加逗號，而且不能用 that，這是非限定關係子句，和第 31 單元的限定子句剛好相反。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Have you met the new director, who transferred from Singapore?
lines.zh: 你見過新的總監了嗎？就是從新加坡調來的那位。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Briefly. He seems nice, but Kevin, who's been here for ten years, doesn't like him.
lines.zh: 見過一下。他看起來人不錯，但待了十年的 Kevin 不喜歡他。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: That's because Kevin wanted the job, which everyone knows.
lines.zh: 那是因為 Kevin 想要那個位子，這大家都知道。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ah, the elephant in the room.
lines.zh: 啊，那個大家都知道卻不說的事。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: And in yesterday's meeting, Kevin threw Daniel under the bus for the delay.
lines.zh: 而且昨天開會時，Kevin 把延誤的責任推給 Daniel。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What? The delay was caused by the vendor, which Kevin chose!
lines.zh: 什麼？延誤是廠商造成的，而那家廠商是 Kevin 選的！

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Exactly. Meanwhile, he's being a total brown-noser with the new director.
lines.zh: 就是。同時他對新總監超會拍馬屁。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: I heard about the meeting. I'm pretty upset.
lines.zh: 我聽說會議的事了，我蠻不爽的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: You should talk to Karen, who always has your back.
lines.zh: 你應該跟 Karen 談談，她一直都挺你。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Maybe. I just don't want to look like I'm complaining.
lines.zh: 也許吧。我只是不想看起來像在抱怨。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Stick to the facts. The emails, which show who picked the vendor, speak for themselves.
lines.zh: 就講事實。那些信件清楚顯示是誰選的廠商，證據會說話。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Good point. I hope the director doesn't play favorites.
lines.zh: 說得好。希望總監不會偏心。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Me too. Let's keep our heads down and do good work.
lines.zh: 我也是。我們就低調把工作做好吧。

patterns.en: I don't want to take sides.
I think there's been a misunderstanding.
I'd like to clear something up.

chinglish.wrong: Karen that is my manager is very kind.
chinglish.right: Karen, who is my manager, is very kind.
chinglish.why: 補充說明已經知道是誰的人時，要用逗號 + who，不能用 that。

chinglish.wrong: He got the job, that made Kevin angry.
chinglish.right: He got the job, which made Kevin angry.
chinglish.why: 指前面整件事的補充說明用 which，不能用 that。

chinglish.wrong: He is very good at flattering the horse.
chinglish.right: He's a real brown-noser. / He's always sucking up to the boss.
chinglish.why: 「拍馬屁」直翻不通，英文說 suck up to / brown-nose。

chinglish.wrong: He put the pot on Daniel's back.
chinglish.right: He threw Daniel under the bus. / He blamed Daniel.

grammar.title: 非限定關係子句
grammar.oneLiner: 補充說明（不是用來指出是哪一個）的子句前後加逗號，只能用 who / which / whose，不能用 that，也不能省略。
whenToUse: 指人補充：Karen, who is my manager, always has my back.
指物補充：The vendor, which Kevin chose, was late.
指前面整件事：He got the job, which surprised everyone.
whose：The designer, whose work won an award, is joining us.
限定 vs 非限定：My sister who lives in Tainan（我有好幾個姊妹，住台南的那個）vs My sister, who lives in Tainan（我只有一個姊姊，順便說她住台南）。
口語講的時候，逗號的位置通常會停頓一下。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文沒有這種用逗號區分的補充結構，通常會說成兩句：「Karen 是我主管，她人很好。」台灣人學了關係子句後，常一律用 that，或忘記加逗號，讓意思從「補充說明」變成「限定是哪一個」。尤其是指整句話的 which，中文完全沒有對應的用法。

examples.correct: Our director, who joined last month, is from Singapore.
examples.incorrect: Our director that joined last month is from Singapore.
examples.note: 只有一個總監，是補充說明，用逗號 + who。

examples.correct: The meeting ran two hours over, which was frustrating.
examples.incorrect: The meeting ran two hours over, that was frustrating.

examples.correct: Taipei, where I grew up, has changed a lot.
Kevin, whose team missed the deadline, blamed the vendor.
The designer who won the award is joining us.
examples.note: 沒有逗號 = 限定（指出是哪一位）。

quiz.question: My manager, ___ is from Tainan, loves spicy food.
quiz.explanation: 非限定子句指人用 who，不用 that。

quiz.question: He was late again, ___ annoyed everyone.
The new director, ___ office is next to mine, is very quiet. (…的)
Which is correct?
options: Taipei 101, that is very tall, is in Xinyi.
Taipei 101, which is very tall, is in Xinyi.
Taipei 101 which is very tall is in Xinyi.
quiz.explanation: 獨一無二的東西補充說明，要逗號 + which。

quiz.question: "My brother, who lives in Japan, is a chef." This means:
options: I have one brother, and he lives in Japan.
The brother in Japan is different from the others.
quiz.explanation: 有逗號 = 補充資訊，暗示只有一個哥哥。

slang.usage: 為了自保犧牲別人。throw someone under the bus。

risk.note: 是很重的指控，私下聊可以，正式場合別直接指名。

examples.en: I can't believe he threw me under the bus in front of the client.
examples.zh: 真不敢相信他在客戶面前把我推出去。

examples.en: Good managers never throw their team under the bus.
examples.zh: 好主管絕不會出賣自己的團隊。

slang.usage: 很會拍上司馬屁的人。動詞 brown-nose。更中性的說法是 suck up to。

risk.note: 來源有點粗俗，職場公開場合避免；用 He's always sucking up to the boss 稍微好一點。

examples.zh: 大家都知道他是馬屁精。

slang.usage: 主管或父母對某些人特別好。

risk.note: 指控主管 play favorites 要小心措辭。

examples.en: A good manager doesn't play favorites.
My mom says she doesn't play favorites, but she does.
examples.zh: 我媽說她不偏心，但她明明就有。

slang.meaning: 大家都知道卻刻意不提的問題
slang.usage: address the elephant in the room = 直接面對那個敏感話題。

risk.note: 正式場合也能用，常作為直面問題的開場。

examples.en: Let's address the elephant in the room: we're over budget.
examples.zh: 我們來談那個大家都在避的問題：我們超支了。

examples.en: Nobody mentioned the layoffs. It was the elephant in the room.
examples.zh: 沒人提到裁員，那是大家心照不宣的事。

review.question: By the end of the year, he ___ three managers.
review.explanation: 複習第 56 單元：未來完成式。

review.question: Every team kept passing the ___, so nothing got fixed.
review.explanation: 複習第 55 單元：pass the buck。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: Because he was late, so we started without him.
Because he was late, we started without him.
review.explanation: 複習第 53 單元：because 和 so 只能選一個。

review.question: I ___ said that in the meeting. It was a mistake.
review.explanation: 複習第 49 單元：後悔做了。

review.question: Could you ___ at the office?
review.explanation: 複習第 41 單元：代名詞放中間。

review.question: He hung ___ on me in the middle of the call!
Which is correct?
options: Karen, that is my boss, is great.
Karen, who is my boss, is great.
Karen who is my boss, is great.
